retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-inspired cosmic layout featuring ornate Art Nouveau custom lettering centered over a gradient sky with glowing celestial orbs.
triggerTerms: ornate swash lettering with drop shadow

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, highly ornate typographic mark with Victorian and Art Nouveau flourishes, set against a deep blue to golden-yellow airbrushed gradient sky containing multiple glowing planetary orbs and wispy horizontal clouds.
coreVisualRelationships: Ornate central lettering acting as the primary focal point
Triangular arrangement of three glowing yellow/orange spheres
Horizontal wispy clouds balancing the verticality of the lettering
Contrast between the sharp outlines of the text and the soft airbrushed background
coreInvariants: Heavy black drop shadow on the main lettering
Double-outline border on the central logo
Grainy, airbrushed texture in the sky gradients

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large custom lettering dominates the upper-center; secondary title text aligned at the very top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large circular swash in the center of the main wordmark.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, drops to the central ornate logo, then follows the diagonal placement of the suns toward the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue space in the upper corners provides breathing room for the complex central typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and cerulean blue sky
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy off-white for the main lettering
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lemon yellow and fiery orange for the celestial orbs
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the lower horizon and orbs; high value contrast between the white lettering and dark sky.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated, curling swashes on ascenders and descenders
Thick-to-thin stroke modulation typical of Victorian calligraphy
Circular enclosures integrated into the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'F' features a massive top swash that spans multiple letters
The 'R' and 'A' are tucked under the primary swashes
The final 'L' has a sweeping tail that mirrors the initial 'F'

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in front of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly ornate custom center-piece paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for metadata.

preserve: The wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the era and ornate curves
Good proxy for the wide-tracked top display text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed 1970s cosmic sky. The top is deep indigo, transitioning to cerulean in the middle and golden-yellow at the bottom. Place three glowing yellow orbs in a triangular formation. Add wispy, horizontal white and orange clouds near the bottom horizon with a grainy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large custom Art Nouveau wordmark in the center using cream-colored fill with a double black outline and a heavy black drop shadow. Place a secondary title in a wide-tracked, white, italicized geometric sans-serif along the top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the central lettering ornate with interlocking swashes?
Does the background have a soft, airbrushed grain?
Are there three distinct glowing celestial orbs?
Is the top text widely spaced and italicized?

mustRedesign: Exact letter-to-letter ligatures from the source
postGenerationChecks: Check for grainy airbrush texture in sky
Ensure lettering has a double outline
Verify the '70s rock' aesthetic is maintained
Confirm the top text is widely tracked
recipe.reuseFormula: Art Nouveau Lettering + Airbrushed Cosmic Gradient + Glowing Spheres + Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif Header
